```{r packages}
library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.linnet)
library(knitr)

x_sub_path <- "data/processed/X_sub.rds"
if (!file.exists(x_sub_path)) {
  x_sub_path <- "0313Fri/CM_data/X_sub.rds"
}

out_dir <- "PU/results/pu_learning_simple"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
X_sub <- readRDS(x_sub_path)

L <- domain(X_sub[[1]])

xy_all <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_len(length(X_sub))) {
  xy_i <- as.data.frame(X_sub[[i]])[, c("x", "y")]
  xy_i$severity <- i
  xy_all <- rbind(xy_all, xy_i)
}

X <- as.lpp(
  x = xy_all$x,
  y = xy_all$y,
  L = L
)
marks(X) <- data.frame(severity = xy_all$severity)

cat("Loaded data from:", x_sub_path, "\n")
cat("Number of accident points:", npoints(X), "\n")
cat("Number of road segments:", nsegments(L), "\n")
cat("Total network length:", round(volume(L), 2), "\n")
```

```{r plot-input}
op <- par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
plot(
  L,
  main = "Manchester X_sub: road network and accident points",
  col = "grey75",
  lwd = 0.45
)
plot(as.ppp(unmark(X)), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.28, col = "red")
par(op)
```

```{r build-segment-data}
road_lines <- as.psp(L)

segment_id_at_events <- as.data.frame(X)$seg
accident_count <- tabulate(segment_id_at_events, nbins = nsegments(L))

segment_length <- lengths_psp(road_lines)
vertex_degree <- vertexdegree(L)

S <- as.integer(accident_count > 0)
degree_from <- vertex_degree[L$from]
degree_to <- vertex_degree[L$to]

seg <- data.frame(
  seg_id = seq_len(nsegments(L)),
  S = S,
  label = ifelse(S == 1, "P", "U"),
  length_m = segment_length,
  log_length = log1p(segment_length),
  degree_mean = (degree_from + degree_to) / 2,
  dangling = as.integer(degree_from == 1 | degree_to == 1)
)

```

```{r pu-counts}
label_values <- sort(unique(seg$label))
pu_count <- data.frame(
  label = label_values,
  n_segments = NA_integer_,
  total_length_m = NA_real_,
  mean_length_m = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_along(label_values)) {
  keep <- seg$label == label_values[i]
  pu_count$n_segments[i] <- sum(keep)
  pu_count$total_length_m[i] <- sum(seg$length_m[keep])
  pu_count$mean_length_m[i] <- mean(seg$length_m[keep])
}

kable(pu_count, digits = 2)
```

```{r fit-two-step-pu}
pu_formula <- S ~ log_length + degree_mean + dangling

naive_fit <- glm(
  pu_formula,
  data = seg,
  family = binomial()
)

seg$naive_score <- predict(naive_fit, newdata = seg, type = "response")

u_rows <- which(seg$S == 0)
rn_cut <- quantile(seg$naive_score[u_rows], probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)

seg$reliable_negative <- seg$S == 0 & seg$naive_score <= rn_cut

train_rows <- seg$S == 1 | seg$reliable_negative

pu_fit <- glm(
  pu_formula,
  data = seg[train_rows, ],
  family = binomial()
)

seg$pu_score <- predict(pu_fit, newdata = seg, type = "response")
seg$pi_support <- ifelse(seg$S == 1, 1, pmax(seg$pu_score, 0.01))

cat("Reliable negative cut:", round(rn_cut, 4), "\n")
cat("Number of reliable negatives:", sum(seg$reliable_negative), "\n")
cat("Number of training rows:", sum(train_rows), "\n")

```

```{r model-coefficients}
coef_table <- data.frame(
  term = names(coef(pu_fit)),
  estimate = as.numeric(coef(pu_fit))
)

kable(coef_table, digits = 4)
```

```{r score-summary}
label_values <- sort(unique(seg$label))
score_summary <- data.frame(
  label = label_values,
  n = NA_integer_,
  mean_pi = NA_real_,
  q10_pi = NA_real_,
  q50_pi = NA_real_,
  q90_pi = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_along(label_values)) {
  keep <- seg$label == label_values[i]
  pi_i <- seg$pi_support[keep]
  score_summary$n[i] <- sum(keep)
  score_summary$mean_pi[i] <- mean(pi_i)
  score_summary$q10_pi[i] <- quantile(pi_i, 0.10)
  score_summary$q50_pi[i] <- quantile(pi_i, 0.50)
  score_summary$q90_pi[i] <- quantile(pi_i, 0.90)
}

kable(score_summary, digits = 3)
```

```{r support-map, fig.width=8, fig.height=6.5}

score_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#c63d35", "#f2b533", "#2e8b57"))(100)
score_index <- pmax(1, pmin(100, ceiling(seg$pi_support * 100)))
segment_col <- score_palette[score_index]

op <- par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
plot(
  as.psp(L),
  col = segment_col,
  lwd = 1.05,
  main = "PU support score on Manchester X_sub network"
)
plot(as.ppp(unmark(X)), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.22, col = "black")
legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("low support", "middle support", "high support", "accident point"),
  col = c("#c63d35", "#f2b533", "#2e8b57", "black"),
  lwd = c(3, 3, 3, NA),
  pch = c(NA, NA, NA, 16),
  bty = "n"
)
par(op)
```

```{r plot-input}
# Optional Step: 5-fold cross validation by accident points

K <- 5

event_seg <- as.data.frame(X)$seg
event_seg <- event_seg[!is.na(event_seg)]

event_fold <- sample(rep(seq_len(K), length.out = length(event_seg)))

point_cv <- data.frame(
  fold = seq_len(K),
  n_train_points = NA_integer_,
  n_heldout_points = NA_integer_,
  n_hidden_points = NA_integer_,
  mean_score_all_heldout = NA_real_,
  mean_score_hidden_only = NA_real_,
  mean_score_original_U = NA_real_
)

for (k in seq_len(K)) {
  train_event_seg <- event_seg[event_fold != k]
  heldout_event_seg <- event_seg[event_fold == k]
  
  accident_count_train <- tabulate(
    train_event_seg,
    nbins = nsegments(L)
  )
  
  seg_cv <- seg
  seg_cv$S_train <- as.integer(accident_count_train > 0)
  
  pu_formula_cv <- S_train ~ log_length + degree_mean + dangling
  
  naive_fit_cv <- glm(
    pu_formula_cv,
    data = seg_cv,
    family = binomial()
  )
  
  seg_cv$naive_score_cv <- predict(
    naive_fit_cv,
    newdata = seg_cv,
    type = "response"
  )
  
  u_rows_cv <- which(seg_cv$S_train == 0)
  rn_cut_cv <- quantile(
    seg_cv$naive_score_cv[u_rows_cv],
    probs = 0.25,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  seg_cv$reliable_negative_cv <- 
    seg_cv$S_train == 0 & seg_cv$naive_score_cv <= rn_cut_cv
  
  train_rows_cv <- seg_cv$S_train == 1 | seg_cv$reliable_negative_cv
  
  pu_fit_cv <- glm(
    pu_formula_cv,
    data = seg_cv[train_rows_cv, ],
    family = binomial()
  )
  
  seg_cv$pu_score_cv <- predict(
    pu_fit_cv,
    newdata = seg_cv,
    type = "response"
  )
  
  seg_cv$pi_support_cv <- ifelse(
    seg_cv$S_train == 1,
    1,
    pmax(seg_cv$pu_score_cv, 0.01)
  )
  
  heldout_scores <- seg_cv$pi_support_cv[heldout_event_seg]
  
  hidden_keep <- seg_cv$S_train[heldout_event_seg] == 0
  hidden_scores <- heldout_scores[hidden_keep]
  
  original_u_scores <- seg_cv$pi_support_cv[seg$S == 0]
  
  point_cv$n_train_points[k] <- length(train_event_seg)
  point_cv$n_heldout_points[k] <- length(heldout_event_seg)
  point_cv$n_hidden_points[k] <- sum(hidden_keep)
  point_cv$mean_score_all_heldout[k] <- mean(heldout_scores)
  point_cv$mean_score_original_U[k] <- mean(original_u_scores)
  
  if (length(hidden_scores) > 0) {
    point_cv$mean_score_hidden_only[k] <- mean(hidden_scores)
  }
}

kable(point_cv, digits = 3)

```
